caseName: Cement Masons Health & Welfare Trust Fund v. Stone
caseNameFull: Cement Masons Health and Welfare Trust Fund for Northern California v. Stone

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of International Training Institute for the Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Industry; Multiemployer Trust Funds; Central States, Southeast and Southwest Areas Health and Welfare Fund; and Health Insurance Association of America for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this ease expressing the views of the United States.
